args.request: Calculate the margin at risk if the Tokyo spot price is 40% higher for the rest of August (2026-08-20 to 2026-08-31).

event.author: contract_risk_agent
event.text:
If the Tokyo spot price increases by 40 % for the rest of August (2026-08-20 to 2026-08-31), the portfolio margin at risk is 886,322,582 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].

### Margin and Risk Overview
- **Margin at Risk:** 886,322,582 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Expected Margin Before Shock:** 567,017,898 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Expected Margin After Shock:** -319,304,685 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Baseload Hedge Cover:** 63.1 % of price-exposed volume (172,608 MWh hedged vs 273,648.6 MWh price-exposed volume) [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Unhedged Exposed Volume:** 101,040.6 MWh evaluated against an average forward baseload price of 21.76 JPY/kWh [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Customers Turning Negative:** 235 customers see their expected margin turn negative following the shock [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Market-Linked Tariffs:** Market-linked customers absorb 0 JPY of margin loss because market-linked tariffs pass wholesale spot prices directly through to customers [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].

### Margin Loss by Tariff Structure
- **Fixed Tariff Volume:** 175,606.3 MWh, suffering a margin loss of 568,451,347 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Bandwidth Tariff Volume:** 98,042.3 MWh, suffering a margin loss of 317,871,235 JPY [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
- **Market-Linked Tariff Volume:** 94,068.3 MWh, incurring 0 JPY margin loss [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].

4. **Tsukuba Micro Devices (C-0014, Fixed):** Margin loss of 50,708,207 JPY, dropping margin to -20,007,563 JPY over 15,743.9 MWh [tepco_retail_desk_demo.customer_forecast_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers, tepco_retail_desk_demo.forward_curve_daily, tepco_retail_desk_demo.hedge_book].
